SITE 2 OF THREE IS ALREADY FIXED — correcting this bead's body, which still lists it as open.

align/sinkhorn.scala was repaired at 11a6685 by the owner on 2026-08-29T16:53:33-04:00, 'align: reject the whole SinkhornConfig domain, not only NaN epsilon'. Line 113 now reads Option.unless(config.epsilon.isFinite && config.epsilon > 0.0)("epsilon") — explicit finiteness AND fail-closed polarity, and the fix was widened past the single field originally reported.

I did not find this by reading the bead. tools/nan-polarity.sh (4447454) did not report sinkhorn, I had asserted in the tool's own header that it would, and chasing my own false claim is what surfaced the fix. A bead body that lists a repaired site as open is the rot pattern in the body text rather than the status field, and it drifts the same way: toward looking more blocked than it is.

REMAINING, verified at main by the survey:
  site 1  align/signature.scala:192 and :212 — MassRatio.unsafe and support. OPEN. Unchanged.
  site 3  features/window.scala — FIXED at 6e92028, now classified GUARDED by chain.

Plus fourteen sites this bead never named, listed at post-01M1A6TR81GRHY4EX834JF6EH4. Polarity only; reachability and consequence remain open questions per the three-question split in the decision note above.
